title: Silicon Horizons
summary:
This episode of The Moonshot Podcast explores how X is reimagining computer chip design to power the next generation of AI. 

Computer engineer Tammo Spalink joins host Astro Teller to discuss Project Positron and their radical decision to build "positronic brains" for robots that prioritize real-time response over raw throughput.
